fusions.name: Wake of Teeth
fusions.desc: Spins the blade around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and making each one [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Frenzied Bite
fusions.desc: A tearing chop that deals 15 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Close the Circle
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds, with +8% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Smell of the Wound
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
